measure: a count of events per entity
gold_sql:
WITH member_trip_counts AS (
    SELECT
        t.member_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM trips AS t
    JOIN members AS m
        ON m.member_id = t.member_id
    WHERE t.member_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.member_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > (
        SELECT AVG(member_trip_total)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS member_trip_total
            FROM trips
            WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY member_id
        )
    )
),
survivor_station_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s.station_id,
        s.station_name,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count_from_station,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS station_rank
    FROM member_trip_counts AS mtc
    JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.member_id = mtc.member_id
    JOIN stations AS s
        ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
    GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
),
top_ranked_stations AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        station_name,
        trip_count_from_station
    FROM survivor_station_counts
    WHERE station_rank <= 5
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS surviving_station_count,
    SUM(trip_count_from_station) AS total_trip_count,
    AVG(trip_count_from_station) AS avg_trip_count_per_station
FROM top_ranked_stations

gold_sql:
WITH maintenance_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        m.job_id,
        m.bike_id,
        m.issue_type,
        m.cost_cents,
        m.reported_at,
        m.completed_at,
        b.model_id,
        bm.model_name,
        bm.manufacturer,
        bm.is_electric,
        CASE
            WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at)
        END AS repair_days
    FROM maintenance AS m
    JOIN bikes AS b
        ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id
    JOIN bike_models AS bm
        ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
),
model_issue_counts AS (
    SELECT
        model_id,
        issue_type,
        COUNT(*) AS issue_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, issue_type
        ) AS rn
    FROM maintenance_enriched
    GROUP BY model_id, issue_type
)
SELECT
    me.model_id AS model_id,
    me.model_name AS model_name,
    me.manufacturer AS manufacturer,
    CASE
        WHEN me.is_electric = 1 THEN 'electric'
        ELSE 'non_electric'
    END AS powertrain_label,
    AVG(me.repair_days) AS avg_repair_days,
    COUNT(*) AS maintenance_job_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.bike_id) AS distinct_bike_count,
    AVG(me.cost_cents) AS avg_cost_cents,
    MAX(me.cost_cents) AS max_cost_cents,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN me.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS open_job_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.issue_type) AS distinct_issue_type_count,
    mic.issue_type AS most_common_issue_type
FROM maintenance_enriched AS me
LEFT JOIN model_issue_counts AS mic
    ON me.model_id = mic.model_id
   AND mic.rn = 1
GROUP BY
    me.model_id,
    me.model_name,
    me.manufacturer,
    me.is_electric,
    mic.issue_type
ORDER BY avg_repair_days DESC, maintenance_job_count DESC

WITH station_trip_span AS (
    SELECT
        t.start_station_id AS station_id,
        MIN(t.started_at) AS first_trip_started_at,
        MAX(t.ended_at) AS last_trip_ended_at
    FROM trips AS t
    WHERE t.start_station_id IS NOT NULL
      AND t.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.start_station_id
),
station_bike_counts AS (
    SELECT
        t.start_station_id AS station_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bike_id) AS distinct_bikes_used
    FROM trips AS t
    JOIN bikes AS b
      ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
    WHERE t.start_station_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.start_station_id
)
SELECT
    s.station_id AS station_id,
    s.station_name AS station_name,
    st.first_trip_started_at AS first_trip_started_at,
    st.last_trip_ended_at AS last_trip_ended_at,
    ROUND((julianday(st.last_trip_ended_at) - julianday(st.first_trip_started_at)), 2) AS trip_history_span_days,
    sbc.distinct_bikes_used AS distinct_bikes_used
FROM stations AS s
JOIN station_trip_span AS st
  ON s.station_id = st.station_id
LEFT JOIN station_bike_counts AS sbc
  ON s.station_id = sbc.station_id
ORDER BY trip_history_span_days DESC, s.station_id

measure: a span of time between two timestamps
gold_sql:
WITH trip_spans AS (
    SELECT
        s.station_id,
        s.station_name,
        CAST(julianday(MAX(t.started_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at)) AS REAL) AS trip_activity_span_days,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS all_trip_count,
        COUNT(t.end_station_id) AS returned_trip_count
    FROM stations AS s
    JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
    JOIN bikes AS b
        ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
    GROUP BY
        s.station_id,
        s.station_name
    HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) > 0
)
SELECT
    station_id,
    station_name,
    trip_activity_span_days,
    all_trip_count,
    returned_trip_count,
    ROUND(all_trip_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(trip_activity_span_days, 0), 3) AS trips_per_span_day_all_starts,
    ROUND(returned_trip_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(trip_activity_span_days, 0), 3) AS returned_trips_per_span_day,
    ROUND((all_trip_count - returned_trip_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(trip_activity_span_days, 0), 3) AS unreturned_trips_per_span_day
FROM trip_spans
ORDER BY unreturned_trips_per_span_day DESC, station_id

WITH electric_bike_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.bike_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
    AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_trip_distance_km
  FROM bikes AS b
  JOIN bike_models AS bm
    ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
  LEFT JOIN trips AS t
    ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
  WHERE bm.is_electric = 1
    AND b.status = 'in_service'
  GROUP BY b.bike_id
),
qualified_electric_bikes AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    trip_count,
    avg_trip_distance_km
  FROM electric_bike_trip_stats
  WHERE trip_count >= 20
),
set_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS qualified_bike_count,
    AVG(avg_trip_distance_km) AS set_avg_trip_distance_km
  FROM qualified_electric_bikes
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN set_avg_trip_distance_km >= 8 THEN 'very_long_average_distance'
    WHEN set_avg_trip_distance_km >= 5 THEN 'long_average_distance'
    WHEN set_avg_trip_distance_km >= 3 THEN 'medium_average_distance'
    WHEN set_avg_trip_distance_km IS NOT NULL THEN 'short_average_distance'

FROM set_summary

gold_sql:
WITH weather_by_borough AS (
    SELECT
        b.borough_id,
        b.borough_name,
        b.population,
        b.area_km2,
        COUNT(w.day) AS weather_day_count,
        AVG(w.temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c,
        AVG(w.precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm,
        MAX(w.wind_kph) AS max_wind_kph,
        SUM(CASE WHEN w.precip_mm >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_day_count
    FROM boroughs b
    LEFT JOIN weather_daily w
        ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
    GROUP BY
        b.borough_id,
        b.borough_name,
        b.population,
        b.area_km2
),
tech_by_borough AS (
    SELECT
        t.depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
        COUNT(*) AS technician_count,
        AVG(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
        MIN(t.hired_on) AS first_hired_on,
        MAX(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS max_hourly_rate_cents
    FROM technicians t
    GROUP BY t.depot_borough_id
)
SELECT
    wb.borough_id,
    wb.borough_name,
    COALESCE(tb.technician_count, 0) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(tb.technician_count, 0)) OVER (), 0) AS technician_share_of_total,
    COALESCE(tb.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
    wb.weather_day_count AS weather_day_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(tb.technician_count, 0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(wb.population, 0), 2) AS technicians_per_100k_population,
    ROUND(wb.avg_temp_c, 2) AS avg_temp_c,
    ROUND(wb.avg_precip_mm, 2) AS avg_precip_mm,
    ROUND(wb.rainy_day_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(wb.weather_day_count, 0), 4) AS rainy_day_ratio,
    ROUND(wb.max_wind_kph, 1) AS max_wind_kph,
    ROUND(COALESCE(tb.avg_hourly_rate_cents, 0), 2) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    tb.first_hired_on AS first_hired_on,
    CASE
        WHEN wb.avg_precip_mm >= 4 THEN 'wet'
        WHEN wb.avg_temp_c >= 20 THEN 'warm'
        WHEN wb.max_wind_kph >= 35 THEN 'windy'
        ELSE 'mild'
    END AS weather_profile_label
FROM weather_by_borough wb
LEFT JOIN tech_by_borough tb
    ON tb.borough_id = wb.borough_id
ORDER BY technician_share_of_total DESC, wb.borough_name

  WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL

    MAX(completed_at) AS last_maintenance_completed_at,

SELECT
  b.bike_id AS bike_id,
  tb.first_trip_started_at AS first_trip_started_at,
  tb.last_trip_ended_at AS last_trip_ended_at,
  ROUND(julianday(tb.last_trip_ended_at) - julianday(tb.first_trip_started_at), 2) AS trip_activity_span_days,
  mb.first_maintenance_reported_at AS first_maintenance_reported_at,
  mb.last_maintenance_completed_at AS last_maintenance_completed_at,
  ROUND(julianday(mb.last_maintenance_completed_at) - julianday(mb.first_maintenance_reported_at), 2) AS maintenance_history_span_days,

FROM bikes AS b
JOIN trip_bounds AS tb

        SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_station_count
    FROM stations AS s
    GROUP BY s.borough_id
),
daily_borough_weather AS (
    SELECT
        w.day,
        b.borough_id,
        b.borough_name,
        w.precip_mm,
        sc.all_station_count,
        sc.active_station_count,
        CAST(w.precip_mm AS REAL) / NULLIF(sc.all_station_count, 0) AS precip_mm_per_station_incorrect,
        CAST(w.precip_mm AS REAL) / NULLIF(sc.active_station_count, 0) AS precip_mm_per_active_station
    FROM weather_daily AS w
    JOIN boroughs AS b
        ON b.borough_id = w.borough_id
    JOIN station_counts AS sc
        ON sc.borough_id = b.borough_id
)
SELECT
    borough_name AS borough_name,
    ROUND(AVG(precip_mm_per_active_station), 4) AS avg_daily_precip_mm_per_active_station,
    ROUND(AVG(precip_mm_per_station_incorrect), 4) AS avg_daily_precip_mm_per_all_station,
    ROUND(AVG(precip_mm_per_active_station) - AVG(precip_mm_per_station_incorrect), 4) AS denominator_exclusion_impact_mm
FROM daily_borough_weather
GROUP BY borough_id, borough_name
HAVING active_station_count > 0
ORDER BY avg_daily_precip_mm_per_active_station DESC, borough_name
